title: The AI is subpar
text: Been using this app for about two years now but looking for an alternative now. I was hoping with time the AI features would improve but it seems no efforts are being made. I give it the most clear cut AI prompt for a flashcard and it’s continuously butchers it. It blatantly ignores clear instructions about formatting and it can never reproduce the same card twice given the same prompt.
Anyone who rated this app 5 stars is lying this app is trash.

title: Exploitative Subscription Trends
text:
The app was great but it's now following the trend of "Yearly discount!" but then monthly being totally unreasonable.

In the past I think the subscription was something like 5 dollars a month which was totally fine. 

But a lot people cannot afford a bulk yearly subscription like this, so I simply cannot support.

title: I’m afraid of updates
text: Guys, I really don’t want to give up on this app, but with each update it’s getting worse and worse. 1. One of my decks is constantly not ready for repetition. A day or two goes by, and it still asks me to wait a minute; 2. The “stale_auth” message keeps popping up. What is this?! Why?! This is a hint that I should switch to the paid version. 3. The new update, which shows when the next repetition will be ready, is inconvenient. It was better before, when you could go into the deck and look there. Is it possible to roll back to the old version?!

title: Poor Offline Use
text: The app only allows you to download a few decks for offline use, and even to do that takes a lot of tapping (3 menu layers). Why? Flashcards are text-based, this should be an easy feature.

title: Mostly good app with annoying bug
text: I generally really like the app but there's one very annoying bug where it closes out of the app when switching to a different app. So if I'm studying it'll reset my progress if I look away. I see others are having the same bug so it's not just me

title: Expensive
text: It’s a cool app, however it’s incredibly expensive for what you’re getting. The app does not allow you to surpass 50 flash cards a day without paying premium prices. It’s also extra ridiculous because it’s marketed toward college students. The majority of us don’t have twenty extra dollars a month to spend on a flash card app.

title: very limited free version
text: Disappointed, you can learn very limited amount of words in free version

title: could be better
text:
1.  The app refreshes itself and deletes the card you were creating every time you open another app. it’s really annoying. 
2. every time you use search bar the app freezes and you have to reopen it   
3. Please add the retention rate after every study session to see how many words were learned and how many mistakes were made.

title: Bug

title: Use ANYTHING else
text: I’m not one to write app reviews, but I’m so upset. Started using this to study for my upcoming Spanish exam, put in tons of vocab words, only for it to tell me that on the free version, you can only study 50 cards a day. For some people, maybe that’s fine, but I am in a difficult course that requires a lot of studying. I figured I’d just export my cards to Knowt, which is what I’ve used for years and should have never switched from, but it uses an entirely different format that Knowt or Quizlet, and so if I want to actually use the cards I made, I’m going to have to input them all manually AGAIN. My test is tomorrow…

title: Let me sign in before onboarding.
text: The app signed me out and I have to go through the long onboarding process before I fan sign it and it’s annoying. It’s not the first time. Also, the offline support is bad; the limit should be higher and it counts cards that are backwards as well which as a card, which sounds like poor engineering. You already have all of the data for 1 card, a backwards card shouldn’t count as 2.

title: Unskippable Ads
text: Added unskippable ads to the app with no warning. Completely disrupted the experience. No longer usable unfortunately.

title: Savior 🥹
text: Noji has been a total lifesaver for me! Seriously, I wish I had found this app earlier—it could've saved me from some pretty intense study sessions 😅. I love the clean layout and smooth performance, which makes cramming a little less painful. Sure, there are a few bugs here and there, but nothing that really affects my progress, just minor hiccups. It's become my study life support during finals! I can't imagine getting through all this info without those beautifl cards. Definitely worth a try!

title: Good app with some flaws
text: I decided to use this app as an alternative to anki as on IOS it costs like 20$. I was pleased with the interface and how easy it was to create cards. I however have some complaints. First, i don’t appreciate how much it bombards you with AI and subscriptions. Second, all my decks just straight up disappeared and without an account i have no why of getting them back. I don’t know if this is a known issue but it needs to be fixed. But overall i think its a good alternative to anki if your trying to save a little money.

title: Healthy app
text: Noji has been a game changer for my daily study routine! I've been using it every day and it just fits so perfectly into my schedule, like I don’t even have to force myself to open it. The AI card creation is super cool, makes learning so much easier. That said, I do wish I had discovered this app earlier! I've noticed a few bugs here and there but nothing major. Overall, I'm really enjoying my time with it and can't wait to see my progress. Definitely recommend it!

title: Connection Issues
text: Really solid and useful anki app; I used it for test studying and it worked so well I highly reccomend if you dont wanna pay 25 dollars for the anki app. HOWEVER.. Why are there even connection issues for a flashcard app
